  • Possible mild dehydration (patient unsure of adequate fluid intake)  
  • No documented fever; reports mild sweating over past 4 days  
  • Known asthma (uses inhaler)

Management Plan

- Advice provided:
  • Increase oral fluids to prevent dehydration.  
  • Monitor for fever or worsening symptoms.  
  • Stay home until symptoms improve.  
  • Avoid antibiotics at present; likely viral or food-borne gastroenteritis.  
  • If diarrhoea, pain, or vomiting worsen, or if any red-flag symptoms (blood in stool/vomitus, high fever) develop, attend in-person GP review for physical examination.  
  • Patient plans to review with GP in 1–2 days if no improvement.

- Education/reassurance:
  • Current presentation more consistent with acute gastroenteritis than hereditary bowel cancer, but family history noted for future screening.

- Follow-up:
  • No specific appointment booked; patient advised to arrange face-to-face GP visit if not improving.
